pagination_comparison.reason: Five original runs completed. Record reader is much faster; replay has long metadata/anchor/TWAP return spans despite empty persisted dependencies and extra reads. Group produces the same rchar/syscr as replay with another assembly layer. Replay preserves returned Input positions for the single informative page-size comparison. Page rows affects both Arrow batching and reference candidate pages; internal cause/fraction remains unmeasured, and a single serial run does not control cache/variance.

measurement_semantics.api_call_span: entire original entry call, including skipped stored records, candidate/dependency reading and reduction when reachable; returned Input kind is correlation, not exclusive attribution
measurement_semantics.classification_overlap: return-kind and returned-input dependency-presence timing aggregations classify the same entry spans; do not add them
measurement_semantics.consumer_span: classification, small-field digests, slow-call retention and returned object destruction; not pure measurement overhead
measurement_semantics.unisolated: Instant, outer-loop overhead and internal component counts/timing are not independently measured
measurement_semantics.not_measured_fields: null with original per-mode not_measured_by_this_entry list; group/stored_non_input/eof slow-call dependency placeholders are projected to null because these returns do not expose Input dependencies; expected_normal_prefix records prior evidence and is not an admission gate
measurement_semantics.io: proc rchar is bytes returned by read-family calls, read_bytes is kernel attributed storage reads and may include read-ahead; neither equals unique Parquet bytes; process deltas stop before writing result JSON; GNU whole-process input/output counts are 512-byte blocks
measurement_semantics.retention: 16 slowest entry calls, total and omitted counts per run; earliest 16 nonempty dependency Inputs, at most first 8 refs each, totals and omission counts retained

group_fact: group id/position/member input positions/close input position
fact position/source refs/direct time/dependency time/quality/direct source ids
token identity and six asset field qualities
excluded: observation business values and all lineage
digest_coverage.claim: selected summary equality only; not complete payload equality or equivalence of an unimplemented optimization

limitations: single run per configured entry, serial order, no independent cache or variance control
entry classification cannot establish exclusive internal cost fractions
read page rows changes both Arrow batching and reference candidate page size; does not rewrite Parquet row groups
no production interface or semantic change; full research storage and continuous-run resources remain unresolved
no probability validation, Brier, formal parameters or profitability acceptance

delivery_output_correction.change: Summary::finish only: group/stored_non_input/eof slow-call dependency fields are null with explicit unmeasured/not-applicable note. Original entry, measurement loops, timing and algorithm unchanged.
